tasks.prompt: The line graph below shows changes in the amount and type of fast food consumed by Australian teenagers from 1975 to 2000.
instructions: Summarize the information by selecting and reporting the main features and make comparisons where relevant.

tasks.prompt: The international community must act immediately to ensure all nations reduce the consumption of fossil fuel (gas and oil). To what extent do you agree or disagree.
instructions: Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
